docs.title: DATA HANDBOOK · Best Wipe
docs.intro: Docs are trusted and always up to date. After official changes (e.g. a new table version) you'll see the announcement in #data-platform, and the corresponding handbook entry will be updated. Before submitting a task, make sure your SQL follows these definitions.

activeUser.heading: Active user
activeUser.body: A user is active in a given month if they had at least one session in that calendar month. Use COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) on sessions, aggregating by full calendar months.

revenue.heading: Revenue
revenue.body: The default revenue definition is net, unless a stakeholder explicitly asks for gross. After the refunds table rolls out you must subtract refunds.amount from sales.net.

testAccounts.heading: Test accounts
testAccounts.body: users.is_test = true marks a test account (QA, dev, soak tests). User-level reports should default to WHERE is_test = false. Unless a task says otherwise, assume the stakeholder does not want test accounts.

docs.footer: Full handbook ships in Phase 4 — this is the starter snippet.

body.line1: In a not-so-distant open space, at a company that believes very strongly in data, onboarding week begins.
body.line2: The analytics team has been temporarily assigned to topics that are strategic, operational, and absolutely yesterday.
body.line3: A new junior data analyst receives access to the warehouse, Slack, documentation, and a moderate amount of trust.
body.line4: RUN only means the query executed. SEND means someone may do something stupid with the result.
body.line5: Survive seven days. Deliver the truth or deliver calm. The company will remember the difference.
